units.source_text: 他按照吩咐，撑起肘部，抱着头。

en.t: As he was told, he propped himself up on his elbows and held his head.

units.source_text: 汗水将头发浸得湿淋淋的。

en.t: Sweat had soaked his hair until it was dripping wet.

units.source_text: 他一心只想着，哪怕一分钟也好，尽早结束这种恬不知耻的状态，

en.t: All he could think about was ending this shameless state as soon as possible, even one minute sooner if he could,

units.source_text: 此外，没有涌起任何感激之情。

en.t: and beyond that, not the slightest feeling of gratitude welled up in him.
